title: LedgerEntry
description: One link of the content-free hash chain (ADR-0006). The entry references what happened and where the content is; it stores no payload, no personal data and no secret. The ledger is the single source for every metric. The first entry of a chain has prev_hash null.

kind.description: What happened, as a lowercase dotted token: run.started, step.finished, decision.confirmed, assignment.rejected. Three kinds record that a result left the system (ADR-0022): egress.write (a connector wrote outward), egress.delivery (a channel delivered), egress.read (an external system read through Taktus); each references what went out in refs.artifact_ids or content_digest. removal.tested records the verdict of a removal test — broke, changed, untested, exception, as outcome — for the integration named in adapter, with the result's digest in content_digest and the removal test's run in refs.run_id. capacity.memory and capacity.storage.<place> (database, state_directory) record that a platform resource crossed into a state a person must act on (outcome act) or came back (outcome ok), naming the adapter that observed and, for storage, the bytes the state occupied in consumption.storage_bytes; refs.tenant is the chain's tenant. run.ended records how a run ended — ok, empty or error, as outcome — with duration_seconds, beside run.finished or run.escalated; trigger.empty records a schedule trigger whose each list was empty, with outcome empty (ADR-0107). incident.raised, incident.recorded and incident.closed record an incident named in refs.incident_id; watch.empty_share records that a process's share of empty ends crossed the tenant's threshold (outcome exceeded) or fell back (outcome ok); watch.configured records a tenant's watch configuration set, by refs.actor. corridor.changed records a new version of a signal's corridor, by the person in refs.actor, with the version's digest in content_digest; corridor.refused records a change refused, with the reason (process, worker, unknown or person) as outcome; an incident of a signal's red value is incident.raised or incident.recorded with outcome red (ADR-0109). proposal.decided records a person's decision on a step Taktus proposed at level 1 or 2 — released, corrected or rejected, as outcome — with the process version, the run, the step and refs.action, the decision's document in content_digest, and no actor (ADR-0110). autonomy.lowered records a level lowered by rule, the new level as outcome (level_1, level_2, level_3), for the version in refs.process_version and the action in refs.action, with the incident it raised in refs.incident_id; run.lowered records that a run took on a lowered level at a step boundary. corrections.configured records a tenant's correction limits set, by refs.actor. residency.configured records a tenant's residency rule set, by refs.actor, with the location it permits as outcome (own, eu or anywhere) (ADR-0116). frame.refused records a connector call a step's frame refused before it was made, or a connector refused as outside the case's scope, beside the step's entry, with the reason as outcome (out_of_scope, scope_not_honoured, outward, outside_source, personal_source, not_declared_free); sources.configured records a tenant's declaration of its sources changed, by refs.actor, with outcome declared (ADR-0130). open_work.admitted records a run that passed its process's caps on open work and is in flight until it finishes or escalates, open_work.capped a run held at a cap, outcome capped, each with the facts the rule read in content_digest; open_work.changed records a cap changed with a person's approval, by refs.actor, and open_work.refused a change refused for want of one, outcome no_approval. connector.called records an outward connector call about to be made, with the digest of its identity — the operation and the digest of its arguments — in content_digest; model.called records a language model's answer to a step; repetition.stopped records a step the rule on repetition stopped at its boundary, outcome calls or model_calls, with the stop's facts in content_digest, beside step.rejected with outcome rejected_by_repetition; an incident of the stop is incident.raised with outcome repeated (ADR-0132). A worker's tool call marked outward is recorded as connector.called with the tool and the argument digest the worker reported, a worker's model answer as model.called, and the first tool call after a model's answer as tool.result, outcome returned; a step the rule stopped at its worker's boundary has repetition.stopped and no step.rejected (ADR-0144). deadline.started records a deadline of a process started for a run, its case, with refs.deadline_id and outcome calendar or working; deadline.refused one that could not start, outcome no_date; deadline.lead and deadline.reached the action taken at a deadline's lead time and at its limit, with the action's kind as outcome (remind, escalate, start) or refused for a start the engine refused; deadline.met a deadline met, outcome step or run_finished; working_time.configured a tenant's working time set, by refs.actor (ADR-0133). evaluation.started records an evaluation of a process on its evaluation cases started, by refs.actor, with its purpose as outcome (change or drift); evaluation.scored records it scored, with its verdict as outcome (passed, regressed, incomplete, first, steady or drift) and the scored document's digest in content_digest; evaluation.overridden records a proposal commissioned against its evaluation's verdict, by refs.actor, with the verdict as outcome and the reason's digest in content_digest; evaluation.case_proposed, evaluation.case_confirmed and evaluation.case_rejected record a case proposed from a correction of the step in refs.step_id of the run in refs.run_id, and a person's decision on it by refs.actor; evaluation.case_withheld records one not proposed because it would keep personal data the tenant does not allow, outcome personal; an incident of a drift is incident.raised with outcome drift (ADR-0134). trace.shared and trace.unshared record the trace inside the step in refs.step_id of the run in refs.run_id shared with the role named as outcome, and the share withdrawn, by refs.actor; trace.retention_configured records a tenant's retention of traces set, by refs.actor, outcome configured; trace.erased records lines of traces erased because their tenant's retention ended, outcome retention. None of them carries what a trace says (ADR-0135). message.held records a message step that sent nothing, with the reason as outcome (undeclared, checks, rejected, unlabelled or answered); message.delayed an approved message held at its boundary, outcome delay or quiet_hours; message.sent a message sent, beside its egress entry and naming the same step, with the digest of its record — the case, the checks and their outcomes, the independent check's verdict, the classification, the recipients' count and the label — in content_digest; messages.configured records a tenant's rules for outward messages set, by refs.actor, outcome configured; case.answered records that a person answered in a case, by refs.actor, outcome answered (ADR-0142). stages.configured records a tenant's stage plan stored, by refs.actor, with its digest in content_digest, and stages.refused a plan refused, with the reason as outcome (person, role, blueprint, looser, above_ceiling); stage.opened records a stage opened by the person in refs.actor, stage.refused an opening refused, with the reason as outcome (unknown, open, out_of_order, predecessor, instructions, no_approval); stage.held, stage.fell and stage.proposed record, by rule, a stage whose condition held, one that stopped holding, and the next stage proposed for opening, each with refs.stage_id; a fall's incident is incident.raised with outcome lowered, beside autonomy.lowered, both with refs.stage_id; autonomy.refused with outcome stage_not_open records a version refused above the level a stage not open allows (ADR-0137). step.retried records a step admitted again after it failed, outcome after_failure, beside the step.admitted that admits it (ADR-0147).

prev_hash.description: Hash of the previous entry; null only for the first entry.

hash.description: Hash over this entry without the hash field itself, computed as the ledger component documents.

refs.description: What the entry is about. Identifiers only.

incident_id.description: The incident the entry is about (ADR-0107).

action.description: The tool action whose level held the step the entry is about: a capability or a connector operation. Absent when the process's own level held it (ADR-0110).

report_id.description: The report to the owner the entry is about: the record its renderings are composed from (ADR-0045).

deadline_id.description: The deadline the entry is about (ADR-0133).

stage_id.description: The stage of a tenant's introduction the entry is about (ADR-0137).

actor.description: The identity that acted, as an opaque identifier. Absent when Taktus acted on its own.

trace_id.description: The identifier of the trace (OpenTelemetry, 32 lowercase hex characters) in which the entry was recorded, so that a ledger entry and a trace can be joined. Absent when nothing traced.

model.description: The model used, pinned as name@version.

adapter.description: Identifier of the adapter configuration that executed. Configuration maps it to a product; the ledger does not.

duration_seconds.description: How long what the entry records took, in seconds: on run.ended, from the run's creation to its end; on trigger.empty, the read of the each list (ADR-0107).

content_digest.description: Digest of the referenced content, so that the reference is verifiable without the content.

rehearsal.description: Present, and true, on every entry of a rehearsal run: a run in which no outward connector operation acted, each answering instead with the recorded response of an earlier real call (ADR-0030). A rehearsed outward step finishes with outcome rehearsed. An entry marked so is never evidence that anything happened outside, and a rehearsal writes no egress entry. Absent on every other entry.
